name: Edward Crowley V
original_name: エドワード＝クロウリー五世
source: Jikokuten of the Four Heavenly Kings. Last in line of great magicians, by mastering Mahjong she was able to reach new heights of her magical abilities. Being arrogant and prideful, volunteers to be the first of the Four Heavenly Kings to battle Kagami Mao.
